chunks: Jamīl ibn Darrāj asked Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about the children of the Prophets عليهم السلام, and he said:
They are not like the children of ordinary people.

key_terms.أَطْفَالِ الْأَنْبِيَاءِ: The children of the Prophets عليهم السلام
key_terms.جَمِيلُ بْنُ دَرَّاجٍ: A narrator who asks the Imam about this matter

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about the children of the Prophets?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the children of the Prophets عليهم السلام have a distinct status and are not comparable to the children of ordinary people. It indicates a special theological distinction connected to the rank of the Prophets عليهم السلام and their households.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4734 - Jameel ibn Darraj asked Abu Abdullah (as) about the children of the prophets (peace be upon them).
Imam (as) replied: "They are not like the children of ordinary people."
